name: webforge-marketplace
description: WebForge Agency plugins. Modular orchestrator + niche vertical slices for the WebForge multi-agent system described in ARCHITECTURE.md. Install webforge (core) plus exactly one niche plugin for your client's type. Add webforge-ops for retainer clients.

plugins.name: webforge
plugins.description: Core orchestrator. Director/Planner/Critic subagents, project.config.yaml schema and validator, and universal operator skills (/webforge:new-client, /webforge:show, /webforge:digest). Always install with one niche plugin.

plugins.name: webforge-saas
plugins.description: SaaS vertical slice. SaaS-tuned Discovery and SEO-Strategist subagents, plus Next.js build and Vercel deploy skills. For type=saas, template=nextjs-marketing, deployment_target=vercel.

plugins.name: webforge-local-services
plugins.description: Local-services vertical slice. Discovery and local-tuned SEO-Strategist, plus WordPress build, Kinsta deploy, local SEO, citations, and site-audit skills. For type=local-services (plumber, dentist, lawyer, gym, HVAC, salon).

plugins.name: webforge-ecommerce
plugins.description: Ecommerce vertical slice. Discovery and ecommerce-tuned SEO-Strategist, plus Shopify build, product schema, review markup, and A/B test skills. For type=ecommerce.

plugins.name: webforge-personal-brand
plugins.description: Personal-brand vertical slice. Discovery and personal-brand-tuned SEO-Strategist, plus Webflow build, calendar embed, and lead-magnet skills. For type=personal-brand (coach, consultant, creator, fractional exec).

plugins.name: webforge-ops
plugins.description: Cross-cutting operations. Outreach, Analytics, and Content-Strategist agents, plus link-outreach, monthly-report, crisis-response, and gsc-monitor skills. Install with any niche plugin for retainer clients in the Iterate phase.
